availability_rule_range_chk.name: availability_rule_range_chk
availability_rule_range_chk.value: start_minute >= 0 AND start_minute < end_minute AND end_minute <= 1440

booking_pending_chk.name: booking_pending_chk
booking_pending_chk.value: status <> 'pending' OR (hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND purchase_id IS NOT NULL)

event_once_chk.name: event_once_chk
event_once_chk.value: freq <> 'once' OR ("interval" = 1 AND end_mode = 'count' AND occurrence_count IS NOT NULL AND occurrence_count = 1 AND weekdays IS NULL AND monthly_by IS NULL AND month_week IS NULL AND until_date IS NULL)

event_daily_chk.name: event_daily_chk
event_daily_chk.value: freq <> 'daily' OR ("interval" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND weekdays IS NULL AND monthly_by IS NULL AND month_week IS NULL)

event_weekly_chk.name: event_weekly_chk
event_weekly_chk.value: freq <> 'weekly' OR ("interval" BETWEEN 1 AND 52 AND weekdays IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(weekdays) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND weekdays <@ '{0,1,2,3,4,5,6}'::smallint[] AND monthly_by IS NULL AND month_week IS NULL)

event_monthly_chk.name: event_monthly_chk
event_monthly_chk.value: freq <> 'monthly' OR ("interval" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND weekdays IS NULL AND monthly_by IS NOT NULL AND ((monthly_by = 'day_of_month' AND month_week IS NULL) OR (monthly_by = 'weekday' AND month_week IS NOT NULL AND month_week IN (1, 2, 3, 4, -1))))

event_end_never_chk.name: event_end_never_chk
event_end_never_chk.value: end_mode <> 'never' OR (until_date IS NULL AND occurrence_count IS NULL)

event_end_until_chk.name: event_end_until_chk
event_end_until_chk.value: end_mode <> 'until' OR (until_date IS NOT NULL AND occurrence_count IS NULL AND until_date >= start_date)

event_end_count_chk.name: event_end_count_chk
event_end_count_chk.value: end_mode <> 'count' OR (occurrence_count IS NOT NULL AND occurrence_count BETWEEN 1 AND 730 AND until_date IS NULL)

event_overrides_chk.name: event_overrides_chk
event_overrides_chk.value: (booking_horizon_days IS NULL OR booking_horizon_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365) AND (min_notice_minutes IS NULL OR min_notice_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10080) AND (cancel_deadline_hours IS NULL OR cancel_deadline_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 720)

occurrence_rdv_capacity_chk.name: occurrence_rdv_capacity_chk
occurrence_rdv_capacity_chk.value: event_id IS NOT NULL OR capacity = 1

occurrence_time_chk.name: occurrence_time_chk
occurrence_time_chk.value: ends_at > starts_at AND block_start <= starts_at AND block_end >= ends_at

ticket_retire_paid_chk.name: ticket_retire_paid_chk
ticket_retire_paid_chk.value: closed_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'retire' OR purchase_id IS NULL

ticket_offer_validity_count_chk.name: ticket_offer_validity_count_chk
ticket_offer_validity_count_chk.value: validity_count IS NULL OR validity_count BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

ticket_type_rdv_chk.name: ticket_type_rdv_chk
ticket_type_rdv_chk.value: NOT rdv_enabled OR (rdv_duration_min IS NOT NULL AND rdv_duration_min BETWEEN 5 AND 480 AND rdv_duration_min % 5 = 0)

ticket_type_buffers_chk.name: ticket_type_buffers_chk
ticket_type_buffers_chk.value: rdv_buffer_before_min BETWEEN 0 AND 240 AND rdv_buffer_after_min BETWEEN 0 AND 240

ticket_type_overrides_chk.name: ticket_type_overrides_chk
ticket_type_overrides_chk.value: (rdv_booking_horizon_days IS NULL OR rdv_booking_horizon_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365) AND (rdv_min_notice_minutes IS NULL OR rdv_min_notice_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10080) AND (rdv_cancel_deadline_hours IS NULL OR rdv_cancel_deadline_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 720)
